author: TEDx Talks
description: There are over 50 active conflicts in the world. Some very visible, others less observed but not less dramatic. Telling the story of wars has always ben complicated, but in recent years it has become both more detailed, and more challenging. We get great journalism alongside from-the-ground social media streams and AI-generated fake videos. Bel Trew is an experienced war correspondent and filmmaker for Britain’s The Independent, who has reported from the Middle East, from Ukraine and other geographies of conflict. In this conversation with Bruno Giussani, author of "Our Minds Under Siege: How to Avoid Being Manipulated in the Age of AI", Trew discusses her experience of seeing war happen in real time in front of her eyes while simultaneously seeing it unfold on social media; how that changes our understanding of modern conflicts; and how news outlets can leverage AI. Bel Trew is a multi award-winning international correspondent, photographer and documentary filmmaker who has spent a d
title: Telling the story of wars in the era of AI | Bel Trew & Bruno Giussani | TEDxBerlin

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the biggest barrier in your life isn't your circumstances, but a verdict you've been carrying about yourself?

After serving a prison sentence in her early sixties, Connie Paglianiti faced the challenge of rebuilding her life while navigating the labels and assumptions that often follow people long after they have changed. But through that experience, she discovered something unexpected: the hardest verdict to overcome was not the one others gave her, but the one she gave herself.

In this powerful TEDx talk, Connie explores how guilt, regret, self-blame and outdated beliefs can become invisible prisons that limit our choices and keep us stuck in old versions of ourselves. Through her personal story of accountability, reinvention and resilience, she challenges us to ask a simple but profound question:

Are the verdicts we are living by still true today?

This talk is an invitation to rethink the stories we tell ourselves and the possibilities we may have already ruled out. Con
title: Prison Without Bars, What Verdict Are You Still Carrying? | Connie Paglianiti | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Noy makes the case that the habits of elite athletes are not reserved for the elite - and that the real goal isn't to build better habits, but to reach the point where your habits run themselves.

Because the best habit is the one you never have to think about. Noy Shani's fascination with data and patterns began at age nine while watching a World Cup match.

That curiosity led to an 18-year career in sports journalism, where he wrote hundreds of feature articles, interviewed athletes and coaches, travelled internationally, and covered major events including two Cricket World Cups and a FIFA World Cup.

Yet what fascinated him most wasn't the stars. It was the people behind the scenes: the former athlete mentoring the next generation, the community coach, and the business owner quietly building something remarkable. He became fascinated by what drives people to keep going and what separates those who perform under pressure from those who don't.

After a challenging perio
title: The power of automating your habits | Noy Shani | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description: Express what you feel in its honest drawing and color. Then consciously add one brighter color. Do it again and again until hope becomes not something you force but something your heart begins to choose naturally. Gladys P. Mangiduyos is a Filipino deaconess of the United Methodist Church, educator for almost 30 years. She has been into Curriculum, Instruction and Educational Leadership in Wesleyan University Philippines. She loves creativity and criticality. She loves creative music, movement, and expression in art. She believes that creativity and criticality are inherent in each person. She upholds that it takes a village to raise a child, hence she has been into empowering educators and other Human Resources in the society to cultivate creativity and criticality. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: When the heart chooses a brighter color | Prof. Gladys Mangiduyos | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Nobody shows you the bent knees.
We only ever see the straight legs the perfect poses, the flawless results, the people who seem to have arrived fully formed without a single struggle.
In this talk, Meenakshi uses one simple yoga pose Uttanasana, the standing forward fold to challenge everything you believe about perfection, progress, and what it actually takes to begin.
This is not a talk about flexibility.
It is a talk about what happens when you stop forcing and finally allow yourself to show up exactly as you are.
Bend your knees. Start before you are ready. The rest will follow. Meenakshi grew up in Meerut, India, before moving to Delhi, where ambition and achievement shaped her outlook on life. Drawn to solving problems, she studied Nanotechnology with hopes of using technology to help cancer patients.

As she navigated a demanding corporate career, balancing work, home, and countless responsibilities, yoga entered her life. What began as a practice evolved into a philosophy tha
title: Forget perfect and bend your knees | Meenakshi Gautam | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk explores why people are so willing to hand difficult decisions over to AI, especially when those choices carry weight and consequences. It argues that while AI can help us decide, humans still have to keep ownership of moral responsibility. Ian Manandhar is a high school student, AI educator, and AI consultant passionate about helping people use artificial intelligence responsibly and effectively. Through workshops, writing, and classes, he works to make AI more accessible while exploring its long-term impact on society, ethics, and the future. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: AI and the Burden of Choice | Ian Manandhar | TEDxMayfield Ranch Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: We have all been bombarded with the catchphrases of modern innovation: "Fail fast and fail forward" and "Move fast and break things." But in the current economic environment, being able to crash and burn is something that only those with privilege can do. In this talk, we investigate the dichotomy between the people whom failure lifts up versus the ones whom failure tears down. Through exploring the concepts of survivorship bias, loss aversion, and system design, we can move towards safe-to-fail social networks. Ananya Balusu is a sophomore at Rouse High School with a strong passion for law and computer science. She has distinguished herself through the Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA), earning recognition as a State Finalist and qualifying as a State Competitor twice. Dedicated to developing her leadership, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, Ananya is driven by a desire to explore the intersection of technology and the legal field while making a meaningful impa
title: The Luxury of Failure | Ananya Balusu | TEDxMayfield Ranch Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the voices in your head are not fighting because one is good and the other is bad, but because they have never learned how to work as a team?

In this personal and imaginative talk, Michael Puplampu introduces the inner voices that shaped his pursuit of success: Michael, the shy and creative dreamer; Titanium, the bold and relentless part of him that wants to push forward; and Mike, the calm mentor voice that helps them finally understand each other.

Through this story, Michael shares a simple but powerful idea: success is not about getting rid of the scared voice or choosing only the tough voice. It is about learning to lead the voices within you so they stop getting in the way of each other and the life you are trying to build.

This talk offers a new way to think about confidence, self-doubt and success.

What if when your inner voices learn to work together, the parts of you that dream and the parts of you that drive can finally all move in the same direction. Michael bri
title: Your Inner Voices Work Better Together | Michael Puplampu | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if we’ve been asking the wrong question about equality?

In this thought-provoking talk, Marleen Mour challenges the belief that equal value requires identical contribution. Through the story of her mother, her journey from Egypt to Australia, and her observations across cultures, she explores how societies determine what is valuable and what often goes unseen.

Marleen invites us to reconsider a deeply held assumption: that worth must be earned through achievement. Instead, she offers a powerful alternative that worth isn’t achieved, it’s acknowledged.

A talk about equality, contribution, and the value that has been there all along. Marleen Mour's perspective on worth, identity, and human value has been shaped by life across two cultures.

Born and raised in Egypt, she grew up observing different expectations placed on women and men. At nineteen, she moved to Australia seeking greater freedom and the opportunity to shape her own future. Living between cultures gave her a unique
title: Worth Isn’t Achieved. It’s Acknowledged | Marleen Mour | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the life you are desperately trying to rebuild is the very thing holding you back?

When Hurricane Harvey destroyed everything Ayo Jones owned, she discovered something that changed how she understood crisis, change, and what it means to truly start over. What looked like the worst thing that ever happened to her turned out to be the best.

In this captivating talk, Ayo shows us what happens when the flood comes for your life, your career, your relationships, your sense of normal, and what becomes possible when you stop running from it and start chasing it instead Ayo Jones, M.Ed. is a Leadership and AI Strategist, keynote speaker, and co-founder of both Belonging Labs and Expat Life Ghana.

She helps organizations navigate technological disruption with clarity, intention, and human-centered strategy.

Her family's relocation from Houston to Accra was documented in a reality docuseries now streaming on HBO Max, Hulu, and TLC Africa.

She has spoken alongside leaders from Googl
title: Saved by the Flood | Ayo Jones | TEDxUniversityofCapeCoast

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the key to great leadership isn't giving more, it's choosing to be self-ish?

In this TEDx talk, Niky Hamilton shares the story of how she nearly went blind while running a business, planning a retreat, caring for ageing parents, and navigating the grief of losing her son. She was overloaded, exhausted, and holding it all together with a pep talk.

What she discovered in a bath that evening changed everything.

Using the simple metaphor of a buffet plate, Niky challenges one of leadership's most uncomfortable words, selfish. She makes the case that prioritising your own capacity is not a weakness or a luxury, but an essential foundation for clear-minded, open-hearted leadership. Niky Hamilton is a former physiotherapist whose life changed profoundly after the loss of her son, Baxter. Through grief, uncertainty, and rebuilding her life, she became deeply curious about resilience—not as the ability to bounce back, but as the capacity to grow through adversity.

Her journey led h
title: Why great leaders are self-ish | Niky Hamilton | TEDxKew

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this captivating talk, Deepannita Sarkar explores the idea of Anviti, an invisible thread that connects our choices, emotions and experiences. Through the lens of Kathak, she reflects on how awareness helps us recognize possibilities, embrace individuality, and find the courage to take the first step toward our true calling. Blending movement with meaning, she reveals how art becomes a bridge between the inner world of emotions and the stories we share with others. Deepannita Sarkar is a Kathak dancer known for blending classical elegance with expressive storytelling. Through years of dedication to the traditional art form, she has used dance as a medium to celebrate culture, rhythm, and emotion. Her performances reflect discipline, grace, and a deep connection to Indian classical heritage. Through her art, she continues to inspire audience to experience the timeless beauty of Kathak. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by
title: The Rhythm of Becoming | Deepannita Sarkar | TEDxKIET

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Artificial intelligence is changing how we work, think, make decisions, and solve problems. As its capabilities continue to grow, the most important question is no longer what AI can do, but what it should do.



This thought-provoking talk puts AI on trial and explores real-world AI scenarios that challenge common assumptions about innovation, ethics, trust, and accountability.



By looking beyond the technology itself, the talk highlights the human judgment behind every AI decision. It encourages leaders and individuals alike to think critically about where responsibility lies, how governance should evolve, and what it means to adopt AI responsibly.



The conclusion is a practical perspective on balancing innovation with ethics by applying a strategy on using AI. The future of AI will depend not only on the intelligence of our machines, but also on the wisdom of the people who design, deploy, and use them.



Ultimately, it's thinking about AI a little differently, one that shifts
title: AI on Trial | Nader Torki | TEDxPristine Private School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Having witnessed his father's years of dangerous underground mining, Rajnish understood from an early age how humanity has always relied on tools to ease the burdens of survival. The dark tunnels, hazardous working conditions, and physical sacrifices of his father's generation shaped his belief that technology should ultimately serve people.

After years in the technology industry, he recognized a fundamental limitation of traditional digital AI: it remained confined to screens, unable to meaningfully engage with the physical world. This realization led him to devote himself to embodied intelligence, developing robots that can perceive, act, and interact with people, taking on hazardous and repetitive tasks where they are needed most.

He believes that artificial intelligence is more than algorithms—it is technology with a human purpose. Every robot deployed in the field represents another step toward protecting human lives rather than replacing them. Rajnish is Global Vice President
title: Why the Future of Intelligence Needs a Body and a Heart | Rajnish Sharma | TEDxZizhu Park

: İngiltere’ye herkesin “hayaller ülkesi” dediği bir dönemde gittim. Ama kendimi küçük bir berber dükkânında sıkışmış halde buldum. 6 ay boyunca aynı ağacın değişimini izlerken şunu fark ettim: O ağaç, doğru toprakta olduğu için bekleyerek yeşeriyordu. Ben ise yanlış topraktaydım. Bu konuşma, şansı beklemek yerine doğru toprağı seçme cesaretinin hikâyesi. Mustafa Özmen, İngilizceyi bir ders olmaktan çıkarıp bir iletişim aracına dönüştürmeyi hedefleyen Meet2Talk’un kurucusudur. Girişimcilik yolculuğunda farklı alanlarda edindiği saha deneyimlerini bir araya getirerek, insanların İngilizceyi konuşarak geliştirebileceği bir topluluk modeli oluşturmuştur.

İngiltere’de geçirdiği 6 aylık deneyim, onun için bir kırılma noktası olmuş; “şans” kavramını sorgulayıp hayatındaki en önemli kararlardan birini almasına neden olmuştur. Türkiye’ye döndükten sonra, sıfır sermaye ve borçla kurduğu Meet2Talk’u büyüterek binlerce insanın İngilizceyle kurduğu ilişkiyi değiştirmiştir.

Bugün Özmen, yeni tek
title: 6 aylık mevsim. Yanlış toprakta yeşeremezsin. | Mustafa Özmen | TEDxBiruni University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
深耕罕见病AI诊疗的张娅教授，以一名”镜面人”患儿十一年误诊的故事开场，引出她牵头研发的DeepRare系统，致力于用AI串联碎片化医学线索。她带领团队整合全球病例、文献与基因数据，构建“勤快+较真”的AI智能体，打破人类记忆、精力与思维惯性的局限，串联起零散病症信号，帮助无数患者缩短漫长确诊周期。她说：“罕见病的困境从来不是病例稀少，而是散落的线索无人拼凑。” 从辗转科室、长期误诊的病患，到精准预判病因、化解家庭焦虑的智能诊疗工具，她用 AI 证明，每一组零散的症状都是关键线索，每一次完整推演，都是在帮患者找回那个早就存在、却迟迟未被读懂的答案。

 上海交通大学特聘教授，人工智能学院副院长、医学人工智能研究院常务副院长。国家级高层次人才，科技部863计划及科技创新2030重大项目首席专家。张娅长期深耕人工智能与医学的交叉领域，提出了医学多模态大模型及智能体系统等技术路线。2026年，其团队在《自然》（Nature）发表全球首个智能体式罕见病循证推理系统“DeepRare”，攻克罕见病确诊难题。她曾荣获上海市技术发明一等奖、上海市“三八”红旗手等荣誉。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: AI如何让罕见病不再罕见 | 娅 张 | TEDxZizhu Park

author: TEDx Talks
description:
〜はじまり はじまり〜
小学校で教師として働いていた。
市口が「社会で必要な力とは?」を探求し子ども達に教育する一方で、
「自分は社会に出た事があるのか?」と自問し学校を飛び出した。
転職・対話・独立・起業を通し市口が見つけた今の学校教育に必要な「共育」とは? I'm 39 years old and currently living in Osaka.
After working as an elementary school teacher, I made a career change at the age of 30 to join a top-tier foreign financial institution.
Motivated by a desire to relearn the knowledge and skills truly needed in society for the children who will shape our future, I later established a company that integrates financial education with emotional and moral education.
In partnership with boards of education, I now work to provide "Education through Analects and Abacus" programs-combining financial literacy and character education—free of charge to elementary and junior high schools across Japan. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 令和    ～論語と算盤(そろばん)共育～　 | Masashi Ichiguchi | TEDxDoshishaU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
儿时被称作皮大王的赵赢，始终怀揣充沛好奇心与跃动的探索欲，长大后扎根乐高集团，化身传递快乐的玩乐侠。他始终坚信玩乐是所有人与生俱来的权利，和团队一起落地乐乐箱、盲文积木两大公益项目，以拼搭游戏搭建表达桥梁，陪伴困境、视障儿童自在探索世界。他说：“最好的沟通从不是追问，而是放下说教，陪孩子尽情玩耍。” 从调皮好动的孩童，到深耕儿童公益的玩乐践行者，他用积木证明，玩乐不只是消遣，更是包容、治愈与自我表达的载体。在他的世界里，每一块积木都是沟通的媒介，每一场陪伴，都是对多元孩童最温柔的接纳。

 他在乐高集团从事企业社会责任工作，长期关注儿童如何在玩乐中学习和发展。他的工作连接儿童发展、教育体验、公益实践与社区伙伴合作，参与和推动过多个面向儿童、家庭、教育者及公益伙伴的项目，包括儿童友好空间、融合游戏、在玩乐伙伴培训，以及医疗场景中的儿童玩乐支持。在这些实践中，他常常扮演连接者的角色：把儿童的真实体验带入成人设计的系统，也把关于玩乐的理念转化为可被体验、共创和行动的具体方式。他相信，玩乐不只是儿童获得快乐的方式，更是他们探索世界、表达自我、建立关系和发展能力的重要路径。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 从皮大王到玩乐侠 | 赵赢 Jay | TEDxZizhu Park

author: TEDx Talks
description:
深耕神重症脑机接口研究的刘秀云教授，从失语失能病患的无助出发，介绍了天津大学脑机接口技术在异常脑状态识别、神经重症、康复、听觉、视觉、精神等常见医疗领域的应用，更分享了当前脑机接口面临的挑战。她坚信科技不仅有机会修补受损的生命联结，更能重塑人的感知与表达。在她的眼里，每一组脑电波都是生命的讯号，每一次信号解码，都是对困境患者最温暖的托举。

 天津大学讲席教授，医学部副主任，药学院院长，先进医用材料与医疗器械全国重点实验室副主任，脑机交互与人机共融海河实验室副主任。国家重点研发项目首席科学家，入选教育部重大人才项目，国家级青年人才计划，天津市杰青。研究领域聚焦神经重症脑机接口研发与应用，获全国首届新时代青年先锋奖，转化医学奖、教育部青年科技奖、Wiley 中国高贡献作者奖、天津市科技进步一等奖（第一完成人）等荣誉。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description: 深耕中西融合音乐的孙艺汇，自幼伴着吉他与爵士乐成长，自由松弛的西式旋律，是她长久以来的音乐底色。她说，民乐与西洋乐从不是对立，而是互通的浪漫表达。孙艺汇拿起失传后复原的中阮创作，不只是为了复原古乐，更是为了让传统民乐碰撞现代曲风，她将古曲《酒狂》搭配爵士经典，把民歌《小河淌水》融入巴萨诺瓦，让东方古韵适配西式节奏。她说：“古乐不该困在旧篇章，它该跨界、该新生。” 当千年中阮奏响世界旋律，沉淀千年的东方乐韵，也在当下焕发全新光彩。 她擅长流行、爵士、R&B等多种风格，嗓音兼具温柔与爆发力，舞台表现力强，师从多位爵士名家学习声乐与演奏，拥有Blue note、草莓音乐节等丰富演出经历。她是中国流行音乐家协会会员，曾担任央视及Dior、Valentino活动表演嘉宾，为网剧演唱主题曲。2024-2025年发行《精神状态良好》《如是说》《临江仙》等多首原创作品及首张专辑《意会TACIT》，风格多元，融合国风、爵士、民族元素。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 东器西乐 | 孙艺汇 Kiva | TEDxZizhu Park
